title: Convoy Event
description: A single line in a convoy's events.jsonl timeline file. Each record is a newline-delimited JSON object.

ts.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the event was recorded.

convoy.description: The convoy ID (matches convoy.yaml id field).

gate.description: Gate type (e.g. spec, design, qa). Present on gate_passed and gate_rejected events.

stage.description: Convoy stage number at the time of the event.

approver.description: Actor who triggered the event. Present on gate and convoy events.

reason.description: Rejection reason. Present on gate_rejected events.

checkpoint.description: Checkpoint ID (e.g. CP-000001). Present on checkpoint_passed and checkpoint_failed events.

notes.description: Free-form annotation. Optional on any event.

duration_hours.description: Hours elapsed for a stage. Optional on gate_passed events.

usage.description: Model usage payload. Present on model_usage events. Records which Claude model produced work at a given stage and (optionally) how many tokens it consumed. Used by `conduit usage report` to audit stage→model policy compliance and surface token totals per convoy.

model.description: Claude model id, e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-6, claude-haiku-4-5.

files_read.description: Files the agent reportedly read during this stage turn. Optional — populated by --read-file flags. Not authoritative (agent honor system).
